meta.title: Day {day} of {days}: Mid Zones Close, Last Call at the Break Room
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day {day} of {days}: the mid zones (Z5, Z7, Z8) close and take Bruiser's key with them; the terminal key is on its last day. Three routes, three encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

clock.short_rest_note: A CAP, not a promise; the GM may end a day early.
clock.day_ends: At the party's saferoom Long Rest, or at 24 in-game hours if they have not had one (the System rolls the day over anyway). The last day is different: the floor collapses at 24 in-game hours into Day {days} no matter what.
clock.lights_out: Stays inside each day as a hazard: every 8 hours the Pit goes dark for 1 hour; outside saferooms the overview's Ceiling Ticks roll applies (00-overview.md section 2 rule 6, section 5.11).
clock.authority: decisions/026-timed-floor-clock-override.md (Caleb; Syndicate confirmations of ~9:25, ~9:35 and ~9:45 PM CT; Caleb rulings of ~10:00 PM CT (Floor 3 = 20 days) and ~10:02 PM CT (a missed collapse is death on every floor)). Overrides the old 'Floor clock: off' wording. The fixed final-collapse hour is a Syndicate default Caleb may veto. 00-overview.md section 2 rule 6 matches these rulings.
clock.canon_note: Canon books have ONE collapse at timer end. The stepwise collapse below is a HOUSE mechanic, tagged inspired.

collapse_order.event: The Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; the Break Room is no longer a saferoom.
Only the stairwell corridor stays; the floor collapses at 24 in-game hours of this day.

clock.closed_zone_rule: Closed zones lose their loot and achievement hooks and the System announces it with a dry floor notice (optional GM color may follow; Lore's wording on the day pages). Zone 9 (The Green Room) saferoom stays open to the end (house exception, inspired).

b70.note: Detour Tax party toll (missed Stairwell key only)
Rest-without-a-saferoom party fee (buys a quiet Short Rest, no Long Rest)

clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. The Z9 Green Room saferoom stays open to the end (inspired). Closed means hooks and services vanish; the route (Z6, Z8, Z9, Z10, Z11) is never cut.
clock.stairwell_opens: About 32 hours after the floor opens, early Day 2 (canon M-276, VERIFIED). The Z10 boss arena also holds a stairwell (canon M-275). The Stairwell key and the Zone S door are house ideas, tagged inspired.
clock.early_descent: A Crawler who descends with more than {stasis_hours} hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last {stasis_hours} hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.
clock.collapse_order_status: confirmed per decision 026; the steps only remove hooks and services, and the Detour Tax is the only toll on the clock (a missed Stairwell key only)

final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day {days} (hour {floor_hours} of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death and revival follow Core Book Ch1, Death and Revival: death is permanent, Costly Revives are the default (rare and expensive), and a Replacement Crawler is the usual outcome. Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling), and Floors 1 and 2 keep the Silver ceiling. Story Boxes are separate: at most one per floor on Floors 1 and 2, outside the box caps and the budget. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

rest_fee_note.text: GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

canon_table.note: Lore's Floor 1 canon table. Tags: canon / inspired / unverified. Each encounter cites its zone id, tag, confidence and ledger rows; the script copies them from the table at build time.

day.start_note: Default start is the Green Room. If the day rolled over elsewhere, start there.
day.collapse_today: Mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close: hooks and services there vanish and Bruiser's key is lost; the route is not cut. Tagged inspired.

tomorrow_notice.text: FLOOR NOTICE. Tomorrow the Break Room and all vendors go offline. Purchase requirements today.

gm_color.text: Buy what you need today. Buy it twice if you're nervous.

rest_options.note: Honest saferoom and open to the end of the floor (inspired). Short Rests and the Long Rest that closes the day.
Honest saferoom through Day 3; it stops being a saferoom when it loses service on Day 4 (decision 026).

A field rest can only be a Short Rest (Core Book Ch1, The Floor Clock and Saferooms: Long Rests only in saferooms). The rest-without-a-saferoom price ({{b70:floors.1.prices.rest_without_saferoom}}) buys a quiet Short Rest and grants no Long Rest; unpaid or noisy, Ceiling Ticks interrupt it (00-overview.md section 2 rule 7). A saferoom is where the day's Long Rest happens (the Break Room through Day 3, the Green Room always). GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

carry_over.note: Zone S service door (stays until the end).
Lights-Out Ceiling Ticks (wandering; cap of two on the floor).

short_rest_slots: Slot 1 (suggested): after the Break Room last call, if needed.
Slot 4 (suggested): reserve; do not push the party to spend them.

last_chance_hooks.heading: last chance before the Break Room and vendors lose service on Day 4
last_chance_hooks.note: The terminal key and the vendor stock end after today. Bruiser's key is already gone.

day.stall_fallback: If the party stalls, the System posts the next-collapse countdown (Break Room and vendors lose service tomorrow), the Lights-Out hour arrives, and the day rolls over at 24 in-game hours. A party that has not bought the key still has the Mystery Key (if drawn), tools, force, or the toll at the door. A Crawler who is not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, with no Reprieve (decision 026); keep the warning in view.

collapse_notice.text: Update: the mid-floor zones are now closed. Loot and services in those zones have ended. Your remaining route is unchanged.
collapse_notice.status: Lore draft v0.2 (floor1-collapse-notices.draft.md), house wording; voice-split [SYSTEM] dry + [GM] color

gm_color.text: The middle of the floor is joining the outer parts in the afterlife. We left your path open because we want you to see what's next. Sadly.

early_descent.summary: A Crawler who descends with more than {stasis_hours} hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last {stasis_hours} hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.

player_prompt.text: STAIRWELL NOTICE. Descent with more than {stasis_hours} hours remaining places you in stasis until the floor collapses. Achievement credit is retained; remaining floor time is forfeited. Each Crawler chooses independently.

gm_color.text: The System won't judge anyone who waits. It will judge a few other things.

early_descent.gm_override_note: The GM may override a Crawler's choice only with a logged reason (decision 026, Syndicate ruling). Never push a Crawler toward early descent; the choice is theirs. A Crawler in stasis has finished the floor; their sheet and boxes follow the Floor 2 arrival rules (00-overview.md section 7.3).

canon_refs.use: Canon: descending with more than six hours left holds the Crawler in stasis until the collapse.
Canon: boss arenas hold a stairwell (the Z10 stage is the house version).

early_descent.sideline_note: A Crawler in stasis is out of the floor, not out of the game. Their player gets short sideline System scenes until the party arrives on Floor 2: waiting-room gags, and a vote on the party's next move. The GM decides how much weight the vote carries, keeps each scene brief, and cuts back to the main table. (Syndicate ruling, decision 026.)

achievements.note: Go down a stairwell more than six in-game hours before the collapse; once per Crawler.
achievements.gm_note: On Floor 1, earnable only via stasis. Reward: see the catalog row (tables/achievements.csv, ACH-1826).

early_descent.reprieve_note: [GM-ONLY] The Floor 1 Reprieve expires when a Crawler descends, whether early into stasis or in the free window (Core Book Ch1, Reprieve). It never covers a missed collapse.

routes.name: Fast, dangerous dash: the Express Lane
routes.path: Z9 to Z10 stage (enc-d05-03) to Z11 or the boss-arena stairwell.
routes.summary: The mid zones close today. A dash is not slowed by that (the route is never cut) but shortcuts through Z8 lose their loot and Bruiser's key. Dash early and the Crawler is in stasis; dash in the last hours and it is free.
routes.stairwell_access: Through Z10 and Z11 as before; the stairwell is open.

canon_refs.use: Canon: boss arenas hold a stairwell (the Z10 stage is the house version).
Canon: descending with more than six hours left holds the Crawler in stasis until the collapse.

achievements.note: Speed Clear: reach the stairwell under the par time.

system_intro.text: Route logged: advance toward the stage. Mid-zone services are offline. Stairwell remains behind the stage.

midpoint_twist.text: The halls shudder as the mid zones go dark behind you. Anything you meant to loot is now a rumor.

win.text: Past the dark and onto the stage. You made it with a light bag and a heavy heart. Statistically, that's a good day.

gm_color.text: Half the building just stopped existing and you're still sprinting. Commitment! The Dean's still at the end of it, and he doesn't care what you left behind.

routes.name: Slow loot-and-achievement route: Closing Time
routes.path: Z9 to Z6 (last day of vendors' good stock) to Z10 wings and Z S.
routes.summary: Z5, Z7 and Z8 close at the start of today; their hooks and Bruiser's key are gone. What is left to collect is at the Break Room (last day of service for the terminal), the stage wings and the Green Room.
routes.stairwell_access: Zone S service door; Bruiser's key is gone, so use the terminal key, the Mystery Key, tools or a toll.

achievements.note: Rumor Mill (last day of the corkboard).
Find a stairwell down for the first time; once per Crawler. On Floor 1 the real stairwell is behind the stage; the Big Green EXIT is bait.
achievements.gm_note: Reward: see the catalog row (tables/achievements.csv, ACH-1825).

system_intro.text: Route logged: remaining open-zone loot before mid-zone close. Terminal key is on its last day.

midpoint_twist.text: The closing sign flips: everything must go, including you. Choose what's worth carrying.

win.text: You dragged half the day's value out before the doors shut. The System calls it 'theft'. The audience calls it 'content'.

gm_color.text: Last call on the middle of the building. The bait stairs, the locker room and the gallery are gone by morning. Grab what you want and run.

routes.name: Clever route: Talk, Trade, Sneak
routes.path: Z6 terminal (last day) to the stage wings to Zone S.
routes.summary: Today is the last day to buy the terminal key; tomorrow the Break Room and vendors lose service. Scout the stage wings, check the pit, and pick a way past the boss or around him.
routes.stairwell_access: Zone S service door with the terminal key (bought today) or the Mystery Key; keyless forcing otherwise.

achievements.note: Find a stairwell down for the first time; once per Crawler. On Floor 1 the real stairwell is behind the stage; the Big Green EXIT is bait.
achievements.gm_note: Reward: see the catalog row (tables/achievements.csv, ACH-1825).

system_intro.text: Route logged: last call at vendors and terminal. Priced bypasses remain available today.

midpoint_twist.text: Nobody knows what you're planning, which is exactly how the audience likes it. The betting has doubled.

win.text: You walked in with a plan and out with an edge. The System checked for loopholes. It found yours and gave a grudging nod.

gm_color.text: Today the terminal's offering one last special on the key. While supplies last, which is until tomorrow. Pay, sneak or scout the stage. The clever Crawler does all three.

stairwell_key.what: The service key for the Zone S door (00-overview.md section 5.8, section 5.10). It opens the service stairwell that drops to Z11 and bypasses the boss.

ways.how: Take it from Bruiser's head in the Locker Room (Z8).
ways.closes: Lost on Day 3 when the mid zones (Z8) close; only if not already taken.

ways.how: Buy the unlisted spare from the Snakk-Matic terminal in the Break Room. HOUSE idea (inspired); the price comes only from the budget file.
ways.closes: Lost on Day 4 when the Break Room and vendors lose service; the price is cited from the budget file.

ways.how: A Mystery Key pull (the Hubcap Key, card f01-z06-0004 or f01-any-0035) can be the Zone S lock if the GM picks it. [GM-ONLY] the lock choice is the GM's, written into session state, never into this page or a deck.
ways.closes: No deadline once drawn; exists only if a Mystery Key was pulled.

stairwell_key.keyless: Thieves' Tools or Strength (Athletics) at the Zone S door works without a key, per 00-overview.md section 5.10 (check values there). It is loud and brings the boss and his ushers looking one minute later.

missing_key_cost.text: Missing the key is a COST, not an instant wipe: a detour (back to Z8 or Z6 while those still serve), the Detour Tax toll, or the loud keyless forcing. Missing the collapse is a different matter: it is death (see the missed-collapse rule).

stairwell_key.fake_stairwell: The Big Green EXIT at Z7 is bait, not a stairwell (00-overview.md section 5.7). Taking it costs time and a fall.

canon_stairwell_notes.text: Canon: stairwells appear about 32 hours after the Dungeon opens (about a day and a half in). House: early Day 2.
Canon: descending with more than six hours left on the floor holds the crawler in stasis until the floor collapses.
Canon: Borough and City boss arenas contain a stairwell (the Z10 stage is the house version).

stairwell_key.availability: Stairwells open about 32 hours in, early Day 2 (canon M-276). On Day 1 the stage and the Z S door can be reached but nothing can be descended. A Day 1 dash cannot descend, so ACH-1824 Not Unpacking (catalog row for canon A-044) is not earnable on Floor 1; it is listed for continuity only.

In the last {stasis_hours} hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.

encounters.name: Last Call at the Break Room

map_in_the_mind.layout: The same carpeted saferoom, but the terminal's screen is dimmed and a hand-lettered CLOSING SOON sign has appeared on the fridge.
hazards: The lights flicker as zones close.

b70.note: Non-combat: no combat budget (daily XP guidance applies)

system_intro.text: LAST CALL. Snakk-Matic and vendor services close at end of day. Complete purchases now.

midpoint_twist.text: The terminal dims its menu one item at a time, like a bar at closing time. 'Spare keys' is the last line standing.

win.text: Receipts printed, shelves bare. Tomorrow the machine goes dark and the coffee finally wins.

gm_color.text: Everything must go, mostly your credits.

loot_hooks.note: Vendor stock is shared floor-wide; price cited at {{b70:floors.1.prices.potion_of_healing_vendor.price}}.
Sports Drink, Blue Flavor: Welcome Box potion; the floor's vendor stock is separate.
Laminated Complaint Card: ask the System one yes or no question about the floor.
[GM-ONLY] Candidate hook for a party that has spent the floor buying and sneaking instead of killing. Record at award; one per floor.

scaling.2: The terminal offers the same stock; a short party should buy the key.
scaling.4: Same; prices from the budget file.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If the party tries to steal from the terminal, the System's saferoom three-strikes freeze applies (canon saferoom rule); it is a cost, never a wipe. If they never buy the key and later regret it, the detour or toll waits (see the key block). If they argue prices, the System says 'no refunds' in a cheerful voice.
encounters.key_deadline_note: Last day to buy the terminal key; the Break Room and vendors lose service on Day 4.

proposed_achievements.name: Read the Fine Print
proposed_achievements.trigger: Use the Break Room terminal bribe route.
proposed_achievements.tag: proposed by Encounter Bot, framed by Lore, reward = slot for Syndicate
proposed_achievements.narration: You read the terms, found the loophole, and paid the fee to use it. The System is almost proud. Almost.

quick_run.setup: The Break Room is on its last day of service and CLOSING SOON is taped to the fridge.
quick_run.decision: Buy the terminal key and supplies now, or gamble on the other key routes?
quick_run.on_success: The party leaves stocked and with a key way settled.
quick_run.on_failure: They leave empty-handed and must use the Detour Tax, tools or force at the door.
quick_run.cut_short: Skip the receipts and the corkboard; take only the key and the supplies.

changes.choice: Buy the terminal key before it vanishes
changes.effect: Buying today means a quiet Zone S entry with no toll at the Day 5 turnstile. Skipping it leaves the Mystery Key, tools, force or the Detour Tax.
Vendor stock is shared floor-wide and disappears on Day 4; what the party buys now is all they will have for the Dean.
The terminal's loophole line is read and the Read the Fine Print nod may be awarded; the Zone S route skips the Dean and forfeits the Boss Box.

encounters.name: The Collapsing Hall: Displaced Vermin

map_in_the_mind.layout: The Locker Room corridor after closure: lockers sealed, lights stuttering, rubbery shutters coming down over side doors, a single clear path to the Green Room.
exits: Doorway back to the Break Room.
Doorway on to the Green Room (Z9).
hazards: Shutters and flickering lights; the main path is never cut.
Rats and Ceiling Ticks displaced from closed zones.

encounters.enemies_note: Confirmed by Syndicate (decision 026, ruling 5), tagged inspired: creatures from closing zones crowd the route. Reuses existing identities only. Counts toward the floor's wandering cap of two if the GM uses the Ticks (00-overview.md section 5.11).

system_intro.text: Zone-close traffic. Hostile units are exiting offline zones into this hall. Clear the corridor.

midpoint_twist.text: A shutter slams down between you and the door you came through. The audience gasps, then shrugs. The other door is open.

win.text: Hall cleared, shutters stopped. The zone behind you is gone for good. Keep moving.

gm_color.text: The hall is closing and so is your window. Rats and worse are leaving the zones that were turned off, and they're all headed your way.

loot_hooks.note: Welding Goggles, Night Shift (Silver): useful in the dark hall.

scaling.2: Fewer rats and no Ticks; the shutters do the pressure.
scaling.4: A full mixed group, as in 00-overview.md sections 9.2 and 9.3.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If the party tries to loot the closed zone, the shutters seal over it and the System posts a 'closed' toast; the cost is a lost round and a spent short-rest slot. If they stall in the hall, the Lights-Out hour arrives and Ceiling Ticks follow. Never a wipe.

proposed_achievements.name: Last One Out
proposed_achievements.trigger: Hold a closing zone until the party is clear, then reach the Green Room.
proposed_achievements.tag: proposed by Encounter Bot, framed by Lore, reward = slot for Syndicate
proposed_achievements.narration: Someone had to be the last one out, and it turned out to be you.

lines.text: The walls start shedding old posters and warning signs. Under them is raw stone with tally marks scratched by earlier Crawlers. Some tallies stop mid-row.
A hallway you crossed this morning is now a gap with a clean edge. You can still see the doorway on the far side, which is its own kind of insult.
Emergency lights flip from white to a tired orange. The recorded voice uses the same cheerful volume as everything else. Underpromise, over-demolish.
A crowd of mobs has stopped to watch the floor fall. They look as unhappy about it as you do.

quick_run.setup: A hall of sealed lockers with one clear path to the Green Room, and vermin fleeing the closing zones.
quick_run.decision: Fight through the displaced vermin, or hold the hall so everyone gets clear?
quick_run.on_success: The party reaches the Green Room and the zone behind them is gone.
quick_run.on_failure: The shutters seal and a Crawler is cut off, paying a lost round and a short-rest slot.
quick_run.cut_short: Run one combat round and one hazard check; skip the second mob group.

changes.choice: Fight through or hold the hall
changes.effect: A cleared hall costs a wandering encounter from the cap of two. A Crawler who holds the hall until the party is clear may earn the Last One Out nod.

changes.choice: Try to loot the closed zone
changes.effect: The shutters seal over it and the System posts a closed toast; the loss is permanent, including Bruiser's key if it was never taken.
The condition the party carries into the Green Room sets whether they need the night's Short Rests on Day 4.

encounters.name: Stage Wings Recon

map_in_the_mind.layout: The wings of the vast auditorium: rolled diplomas, a trophy table, camera lights in the dark, the orchestra pit at the front edge.
hazards: The orchestra pit edge (a usable hazard).
Ushers on watch if the party is spotted.

encounters.enemies_note: Ushers are on watch only if the party is spotted. Dean Thudd is on the stage, see enc-d05-03.

system_intro.text: Stage wings. Observation position before the pit. Pit entrance is adjacent.

midpoint_twist.text: A drone swings your way, its little red light blinking like a nervous bird. The audience would love for you to break it. So would the Dean.

win.text: You've seen enough. The stage is a plan, now, and not a surprise.

gm_color.text: The wings. Where heroes wait and stagehands judge them. Take notes. The pit is right there.

loot_hooks.note: Library Sneakers (Silent Edition): helpful for sneaking past the Ushers.
Hi-Vis Safety Vest, Reflective: a funny disguise for a staff area.

[GM-ONLY] Candidate hook if a Crawler beats or drives off a named hostile using only the room (orchestra pit, trophy table), no weapon or spell of their own. One per floor; pick one deed; do not pre-promise.

achievement_hooks.note: Environmentalist (setup; pays if the pit finishes the boss).

scaling.2: A shorter scout and fewer watchers.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If someone wanders on stage too early, the Dean notices and the boss encounter starts (enc-d05-03) without the scout bonus. If someone breaks a drone loudly, the Ushers come. Never a wipe.

quick_run.setup: The stage wings: a trophy table, camera lights and the orchestra pit.
quick_run.decision: Scout quietly for the Dean's weak points, or loot the table and risk being spotted?
quick_run.on_success: The party learns a cheese route and the Ushers' watch pattern.
quick_run.on_failure: The Ushers spot them and raise the alert for Day 4.
quick_run.cut_short: Give the three scouting facts (pit, spotlight, watch pattern) and roll one stealth check.

changes.effect: Each cheese route learned (pit, spotlight, booth) is available in the Day 5 fight; the Ushers' watch pattern shapes the Day 4 approach.
A spotted party faces alerted Ushers at the stage door on Day 4.

changes.choice: Take items from the trophy table
